caseName: West v. American Telephone & Telegraph Co.
caseNameFull: West v. American Telephone & Telegraph Co.
attorneys: Messrs. Harry L. Deibel and Orlin F. Goudy for petitioners. Mr. William B. Cockley for respondent.

opinions.text: The motion to use the certified record in Nos. 44 and 45, October Term, 1940, and to dispense with the printing thereof, is granted. The petition for writ of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Sixth Circuit is denied.
